title: Paton Hall in Hamilton - August Update #1
metaDescription: Update for the Paton Hall Hardware Hub project in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada.
introContent: Thank you for your interest in making this new community hub a reality. During Summer and Fall '26, all efforts are directed at securing the 4 Breadalbane space near King St West and Dundurn. The vision and roadmap are being iterated on GitHub under the 'patonhall' org. A website for the project has been created at: https://patonhall.github.io/site. Why now?
